A '''mining outpost''' was built on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Keres II]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]]. The outpost [[Mining/Legends|mined]] several [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] deposits and other ores found on the planet. In around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]] the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] stationed there abandoned the post due to the thawing of a frozen [[Keres II terentatek|terentatek]] that had been buried deep in the mines. This allowed scavengers to move in and claim the deposits while avoiding the [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]].<ref name="TCM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The outpost was first mentioned as part of the scavenging crew skills mission "The Carbonite Mines" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
